backend/main.mo: Motoko backend actor handling user profiles, stats, availability records, chat messages, and access‑controlled mutations with storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing required logo‑replacement updates across specific frontend files with associated metadata.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of all major frontend files describing their role in routing, hooks, components, pages, and styling.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base/theme definitions using OKLCH variables for light and dark mode with global background and text settings.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading the React app via main.tsx with a root container.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app configuring authentication gating, profile setup, leaderboard initialization, and TanStack Router route definitions.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: UI card informing users they lack admin access with a button to return to the calendar.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginScreen: Login screen with background image, blurred card, and app logo using Internet Identity login.
frontend/src/components/branding/AppLogo: Simple logo component rendering the app logo URL from branding settings.
frontend/src/components/chat/ChatPanel.t: Group chat panel showing recent messages, avatars, timestamps, and an input box with scroll management.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Defines the main app layout with top bar, navigation, content slot, and footer.
frontend/src/components/layout/Navigatio: Renders navigation buttons and conditionally adds an admin link based on user role.
frontend/src/components/layout/TopBar.ts: Displays the app header with logo, user menu, theme toggle, and logout handling.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileC: Shows and edits user profile details including name and profile picture upload with validation.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileS: Modal prompting new users to enter their name and save their initial profile.
frontend/src/components/theme/Background: Wraps children with a full‑screen background image layer.
Displays a user avatar with initials fallback and name text in configurable sizes.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor instance tied to identity, invalidating queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: Fetches and updates the current user's profile using the actor API.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserRole.ts: Retrieves the caller's role and admin status from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context with login, logout, identity persistence, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles, availability data, leaderboard info, and messages via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useTheme.ts: Manages light/dark theme state with localStorage persistence and toggling.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserDirectory.ts: Fetches user display names and avatars for lists of principals, with utilities for fallback formatting.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and theme CSS variables for light and dark modes.
frontend/src/lib/branding.ts: Exports static branding constants like app name and logo details.
frontend/src/lib/date.ts: Utility functions for converting dates to IDs, formatting dates and times, and generating month views.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with Internet Identity and React Query providers.
frontend/src/pages/AddAvailabilityPage.t: UI page for adding or editing a user's availability with date selection, time options, and notes.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin interface for viewing and deleting users and availabilities with directory lookups and sorting.
frontend/src/pages/CalendarMonthPage.tsx: Renders a monthly calendar with navigation, day cells showing availability, and an embedded chat panel.
frontend/src/pages/ChatPage.tsx: Displays a simple page wrapper containing the group chat panel.
frontend/src/pages/DayDetailPage.tsx: Shows availability details for a specific day with options to edit or delete the user's availability.
frontend/src/pages/LeaderboardPage.tsx: Provides a tabbed leaderboard view with player stats and actions to record wins or losses.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Renders the user profile view with a profile card and placeholder match history section.
frontend/src/utils/file.ts: Utility functions for converting files to Uint8Array and generating name initials.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Helpers for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with extended themes, colors, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks project metadata and requirements, including replacing the app logo across the UI.
